summary: TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. 26/26 keys; Archon re-cut + Wowhead rebuild = 6 tier, 2 consensus moves. WCL rdps broken, 3 raw keys. Murlok held (S2 reset).

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 182-329 KB. Parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = the tier letter, each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally): raid 27/7/6 and M+ 26/7/6 = 79 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves against stored. The M+ DPS shortfall is the literal upstream TBD row — Subtlety Rogue sits in a row whose tier cell reads "TBD", stored as an explicit null and never omitted or guessed (the page's other rows carry S+/S/A+/A/B/C; no B+ was populated today). Era read from each page's own title AND changelog body: five titles self-identify as 12.1 / Season 2, and the raid-HEALER page again keeps a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a changelog whose newest entries read "13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch after the first few live tests" and "11 Aug. 2026: Updated for Midnight Season 2 launch" — body over title per the blue-tracker precedent, so seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no seasonVerified value changed this run (nothing for freeze-season.mjs to freeze). published re-read per page rather than carried forward — raid DPS 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-13 (JSON-LD dateModified; the in-body "Last UPDATED" says 08-10 and dateModified wins), raid tank 08-08, M+ x3 08-08 — agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Page snapshots advanced 2026-08-15 -> 2026-08-16.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 189-325 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way this era-gated source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 39 rated assignments (26 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves — no rebuild since the 2026-08-09 cut, consistent with the Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is again the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null; 39 rated rows against a floor of 24. published RE-READ from each page, never carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with the deterministic published-evidence artifact (the in-body "Last UPDATED" still says 08-02; dateModified wins per refresh-tiers precedence). Snapshots advanced to 2026-08-16. It never feeds the live consensus (era-gated) and is only a projection input, so its quiet week moves no published letter.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Non-roster alts were rejected by ROSTER MATCH and never by position — the 8 Season-2 dungeon names (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) on the M+ page and the Method logo on both. Self-dates unchanged: raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026", M+ "13th August 2026". Era re-verified from the bodies: the raid page names "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" and the M+ page "Mythic+ content and dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2", with zero Season 1 mentions on either — seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right, into the next-patch forecast, its final s1 letters held in data/season-final.json so the consensus composition is unchanged.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set, HTTP 200, 73-328 KB (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Parsed by unescaping \/ across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], with tolerant whitespace inside each [tier-label] and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. 80 assignments (27/7/6 per bracket), 0 unmatched. ONE tier move: Holy Priest raid A -> B. It is upstream, not parse drift, and is corroborated by the page itself — the raid-healer page's JSON-LD dateModified moved 2026-08-08 -> 2026-08-16T00:20:29-05:00, matching published-evidence/evidence.json exactly, and its single [tier-list=rows] block reads S Discipline/Preservation, A Holy Paladin/Restoration Shaman, B Restoration Druid/HOLY PRIEST/Mistweaver. (That page carries TWO WH.markup.printHtml calls but only one tier-list block, so the known decoy could not be in play.) Other self-dates re-read and unchanged: raid DPS 08-14, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS 08-15, M+ healer 08-09, M+ tank 08-11 — 6/6 agreement with the evidence artifact; the raid-healer published value was updated to 2026-08-16. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD, same disposition as Icy Veins and Method).

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> (WebFetch markdown drops it): specTierListSection.tierLists read at metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping, with every entry resolved from its icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name (Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter" / "Havoc DemonHunter"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. FIVE tier moves, all raid: healer Holy Priest B -> A and Mistweaver Monk B -> C; tank Protection Paladin C -> B, Brewmaster Monk C -> B and Vengeance Demon Hunter B -> C. These are real and corroborated by the numbers on the same pages — Archon has re-cut since the previous run even though its lastUpdated label is still pinned at 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z: every one of the 33 raid DPS/tank rows and all 7 healer rows moved in value and/or parse count (Holy Priest 95th-pct HPS 230,745 -> 239,634 vaults it past Restoration Shaman's 235,907, which is exactly the A it now reads; Vengeance DH raid DPS 95,424 -> 72,432 on 25 -> 32 parses). Reading the label as the data date would have hidden this, and it is the same failure mode the previous run correctly held back for when the label ticked ahead of the data. Era: still Season 1 — encounterOptions are the nine S1 bosses (Imperator ... Midnight Falls) and the M+ selector still lists the eight S1 dungeons (Algeth'ar Academy, Magisters', Maisara Caverns, Nexus-Point Xenas, Pit of Saron, Seat, Skyreach, Windrunner Spire) — so seasonVerified stays s1 and Archon remains the only source feeding the live consensus in its own right. Net published effect: 2 consensus letters, both raid, both one band (Brewmaster Monk B -> A, Mistweaver Monk A+ -> A).

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200 with __NEXT_DATA__ present, 618 tier rows parsed, 0 unmatched icons. 51 stored tier rows changed, ALL of them raid — the same Archon re-cut the aggregate pages show; the M+ per-dungeon tiers are byte-identical, consistent with Season 1 keys being dead content. Six role cuts publish an EMPTY tier list upstream (Crown all three roles, Chimaerus healer+tank, Vanguard tank) and three are short (Vaelgor & Ezzorak DPS 26/27 and tank 5/6, Vanguard DPS 26/27); per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule the 59 stored rows those cuts do not reproduce were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased, so data/encounter-tiers.json still holds 677 tier rows against a floor of 440. The committed encounter `name` values were not rewritten (page.title is the generic page headline, not the boss name). File asOf set to Archon's own label 2026-08-15, never the run date.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically — the third of Archon's three raid tierLists, alongside popularity and throughput): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, ZERO tiers moved even though the underlying survivability percentages did (Holy Priest still S at 96.0%, Protection Warrior still S at 95.7%). spec.survivability therefore keeps its stored asOf 2026-08-14 — nothing moved, so nothing was re-dated; the gated date for this requirement is the page snapshot, which advanced to 2026-08-16 on a genuine live re-read. Standing caveat unchanged: the Season-1 raid sample behind these tiers is content that is now dead, so quiet here means frozen rather than settled.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) across the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count, floats rounded to the stored integer precision. ALL 33 moved this time — every spec's parse count grew (Devourer 602 -> 621, Blood DK 404 -> 420, Vengeance DH 25 -> 32) and 20 values moved with them — so Archon has genuinely re-cut since the 08-14 merge, unlike the previous run where the label had ticked but the numbers had not. Merged at Archon's OWN date 2026-08-15 (its lastUpdated label), never the run date; coverage date is now 2026-08-15 (1 day, threshold 5). Largest single move is Vengeance DH 95,424 -> 72,432 DPS (-24%), well inside maxValueMovePct 0.6, and the family median move is far inside maxFamilyMedianMovePct. The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection.table.data[] (hps column, n = parses): 7/7 healer specs, 0 unmatched. All seven moved in parse count and five in value — Holy Priest 230,745 -> 239,634 (152 -> 165 parses), Restoration Shaman 243,899 -> 235,907, Mistweaver 222,624 -> 215,733, Holy Paladin 262,453 -> 261,040, Restoration Druid 225,866 -> 225,086 — which is what drives the two Archon healer tier moves reported under archon-tiers. Merged at Archon's own 2026-08-15; coverage 1 day against a threshold of 5. Reported as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never hide behind the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ aggregate pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] (score column, n = parses): 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, every value AND every parse count byte-identical to stored — unchanged since the 08-10 cut, while the raid series on the same site moved tonight. Archon's M+ numbers are genuinely frozen: Season 1 keys have been dead content since 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so the population feeding the 95th percentile has stopped growing. Nothing merged (adopting tonight's re-stamped label over unmoved numbers is the exact failure this row held back for last night), so the stored coverage date stays 2026-08-10 — 6 days against a threshold of 5, which alarms on the heartbeat. That red is the correct signal: it says Archon has no live Season-2 M+ data yet, not that the fetch failed.

"Popularity" re-read from specRankingsSection.table.data[] across all six aggregate pages = 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched. Shape-checked BEFORE merging, per the 2026-07 failure that published DPS magnitudes under unit %: every value is a plausible percentage, the six (role x bracket) groups sum to 100.0 / 100.1 / 100.0 / 99.8 / 100.0 / 100.0 (total 599.9), and no row equals that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)". The 40 RAID rows all moved with the re-cut and were merged at Archon's own 2026-08-15; the 40 M+ rows are byte-identical and were left at 2026-08-10 rather than re-dated. PARTIAL because the requirement's coverage date is the 60th-freshest of 80 rows, which is therefore still 2026-08-10 (6 days, threshold 5) — the honest reading is "half this family advanced tonight and half is frozen with Season 1".

Both JSON API calls fetched fresh with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, never the HTML page (a stale S3 prerender). manifest.json gives snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returns 44 blocks, of which the whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField "lowerBound" + keyRange undefined selects 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and are excluded, not merely "not dungeon"). classSpec names matched the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. The rankings file was DIFFED rather than trusted to its manifest — the 08-04 incident had a pinned snapshotDate over changed values — and this time both agree: Last-Modified is Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters are identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (5 days, threshold 8), never today.

This agent holds no WCL credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means; the only input is the pre-agent wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-16T10:54:32Z), whose verdict is "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error" (httpStatus 200, 0 rankings) while OAuth and GraphQL transport are both healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent). The evidence lands no rows for this key, so the 47 stored zone-46 Mythic rDPS/HPS median rows stay unchanged at 2026-08-10 (6 days, threshold 10). The HTML statistics transport that used to serve this cut is separately dead (Cloudflare human-challenge since 08-10, re-measured from a residential IP on 08-14), so there is no second path to try and no honest substitute — the dps-family numbers that DO return must never be published under an rDPS-labelled series.

Same single input and same verdict as wcl-live-raid: wcl-fetch/evidence.json reports "rdps-broken" and lands no rows for this key, so the 40 stored zone-47 M+ median rows (27 rDPS + 6 tank rDPS + 7 HPS) stay unchanged at 2026-08-10 (6 days, threshold 10). Standing distinction kept in view: "rdps-broken" is a statement about the v2 GraphQL API, not about rDPS data — but with the HTML statistics endpoint also challenged, neither path is open tonight.

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken", no rows landed for this key, so the 34 stored "12.1 PTR raid testing score (normalized)" rows stay at 2026-07-28 (19 days, threshold 40 — the temporary ceiling set 2026-08-05 for exactly this state). Two independent reasons this cut cannot come back on our side: the zone-54 cross-boss normalized 0-100 score has NO GraphQL analogue at all (only the HTML statistics table ever published it, and that transport is Cloudflare-challenged), and the PTR raid-testing window closed when 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so there is nothing upstream to refill it with either. The zone-54 RAW-DPS pooled series is a different recipe on a different transport and did land tonight (see wcl-ptr-raid-raw).

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken" and no rows landed for this key, so the 40 stored "Median rDPS/HPS (12.1 PTR M+ testing)" rows stay unchanged at 2026-08-10 (6 days, threshold 10). The zone-56 RAW-DPS sibling (wcl-ptr-mplus-raw) DID land tonight from the same evidence file: the two series ride different recipes, and a healthy raw fetch is never evidence that the rdps family is fixed.

spec.ptrDummy stores median rDPS by fixed target count and therefore depends on the same broken rdps metric family; the evidence file lands no rows for this key, so all 27 stored ptrDummy records stay at 2026-08-10 (6 days, threshold 10) and the build's Dummy Dome composite is computed from unchanged data. The zone-52 RAW-DPS medians are a DIFFERENT statistic and did land (see wcl-dummy-raw) — raw DPS is never dressed up as rDPS.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-dummy-raw"] alone, which this agent can neither produce nor edit: 102 rows built and 102 applied by the deterministic pre-agent step, with all four DPS dummies ok — 1T 2000 ranked players, 2T 664, 3T 297, 5T 2000 (complete pagination per the frozen 2026-07-17 recipe; rankings are best-parse-per-player sorted best-first, so a partial median would be biased high). 102 of the 106 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)" rows now carry asOf 2026-08-16; the four that do not are 5T rows for specs with no parse in this cut, left untouched rather than re-dated. Coverage date 2026-08-16 (0 days, threshold 10). The fetch step merged these itself before this agent started — they were neither re-fetched, recomputed nor edited here.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across the zone-54 Heroic boss pool, all eight encounters ok — Nek'zali the Soulcoiler 370 ranked players, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik the Malignant 678, The Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, The Twin Fangs 146, and The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek at 0, which is an empty encounter rather than an error. All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Venomous Abyss, pooled)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-16. Written from the evidence file only; no WCL fetch of any kind was performed by this agent.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across all eight zone-56 dungeons, each returning the 2000-player pagination ceiling (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR M+ keys, pooled)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-16. Written from the evidence file only; this agent performed no WCL request.

All three meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 8.5-9.5 KB compressed, anchored on the meta-item class with the href read out of the tag (an href-anchored split found only 10 of 40 rows on 08-15 while every page still returned 200). Upstream has moved and the merge is HELD BACK WHOLESALE, because what arrived is a season boundary rather than a normal cut: the DPS page now lists only 22 of 27 specs (Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Retribution Paladin and Elemental Shaman are absent entirely), five more read a literal 0 (Devastation Evoker, Marksmanship Hunter, Arcane Mage, Frost DK, Preservation Evoker), and every remaining value has dropped hard — Guardian Druid 4268 -> 4123, Blood DK 3990 -> 3286, Holy Paladin 3935 -> 3131, Discipline Priest 3998 -> 3460 — which is the shape of Season 2 ratings rebuilding from a reset, five days after 12.1 shipped. The page's own <time datetime> moved 2026-08-12T02:17Z -> 2026-08-16T02:11:23Z, yet its title and h1 still read "Midnight Season 1". Merging is refused on two counts: the five zero rows are 100% value moves that would trip maxValueMovePct 0.6, which has NO agent-writable ack path, and merging the other 30 alone would publish an S1/S2 mixed pool under one series name — the same defect the bloodmallet tier-uniformity gate exists to prevent. Stored data is byte-identical and stays at 2026-08-15 (1 day, threshold 5). OWNER DECISION NEEDED: whether "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" should be re-based (or paused) at the Season-2 flip, since the S1 and S2 numbers are not the same quantity.

All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each (the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body is transient, not structural). FOURTEEN charts returned data and 13 still answer with the error body after 3 tries — Augmentation Evoker is the known by-design absence, the other 12 (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Assassination, Outlaw, Demonology, Arms, Fury) are simply not re-simmed yet. The roster is unchanged from last night: the same 14 carry simc_settings.tier MID2 (all 14 chart timestamps read 2026-08-15) against MID1-era stored profiles. Per the tier-uniformity gate the merge is HELD BACK WHOLESALE — MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so merging the 14 would publish "which specs bloodmallet has re-simmed" as spec strength. Stored fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHART's own 2026-07-08 (39 days, threshold 5) and the heartbeat stays red — that red is the true signal that upstream has not finished. Note for the night the roster completes: a wholesale adoption will also need a human value_move_ack, since 64 of 156 sim rows move more than 60%.

Both transports checked. MID1_Raid.txt is again a live in-progress log (272 bytes, no "DPS Ranking:" block) whose header reads "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69299 Live (hotfix 2026-08-15/69299, git build HEAD 6641c13132, no-networking)" — a Season-2 re-sim is running right now, and its git build has moved again since last night's b642585cbf. MID1_Raid.html therefore remains the only parseable report and it has NOT advanced: SimulationCraft 1205-01 for WoW 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974), git build 678e66d384, report timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000 — identical provenance to the stored cut, so an unchanged parse is the honest explanation rather than a fresh sim dressed up as one. Era-verified off that header string, not the visible "12.3.0" (which is the Highcharts version). Nothing merged; stored date stays 2026-08-08 (8 days, threshold 10). Expect a large one-off move when the 12.1 report publishes.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), HTTP 200, 184 KB uncompressed — curl's size_download reads 11.5 KB with --compressed and must not be read as an empty page. It 302-resolves to period 1075, MID1 week 20, the SAME period as the previous run, so no weekly roll and no half-landed roll. The parse was bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and stopped at the "Classes and specs" heading (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the per-dungeon blocks); labels read from the lowercase-hyphenated alt attribute and normalised on both sides, values taken from the trailing number rather than the bar's height style. 34 specs returned, summing to 100.3% with role subtotals 60.2 DPS / 20.1 healer / 20.0 tank — the representation SHARE column, not the /meta per-key-presence figure. All 34 values are identical to stored; the 6 specs absent upstream are stored as explicit 0 and were left untouched. Nothing merged, so the coverage date stays 2026-08-14 (2 days, threshold 5).

Four channels swept, nothing new to log. (1) Official dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest is Linxy #19 — already the feed's 07-31 entry, and the thread has been quiet for 16 days because the PTR cycle ended when 12.1 shipped. (2) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block: 40 items, newest 2026-08-16 06:05 CDT; nothing class-relevant beyond what is logged. (3) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) polled as well, since it leads RSS within a run: 20 posts, top id 382474, nothing beyond RSS. (4) Blue-tracker payload (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries deduped to 42 topics, newest 2026-08-14 20:02; the only class-touching blues remain Linxy's "Class Tuning Incoming – August 18" (topic 2336820), which IS the feed's newest entry (the 2026-08-15 build), and the Aug-14 Kaivax hotfixes (topic 2336376), re-read in full tonight and again confirmed non-feed material: its Classes section is entirely bug fixes (Devastation Shattering Star/Mastery, Warrior Slayer Executioner double effect, Warlock pet Soul Leech, Demonology Soul Harvest) while every numeric change in the post is trinkets and items. The Aug-13 hotfix round-up is the same shape. Writing either as "Spec Class - ..." highlights would put bug-fix text into the outlook tally. One LEAD still open but not logged: "Patch 12.1.5 PTR Now Listed on Battle.net Launcher" (news 382443, 08-13) — a new cycle means a NEW forum thread, but the article states the patch has not been updated and nothing is datamineable yet. Writeup coverage RECOMPUTED rather than read from prose: exactly one spec has no ptr writeup (Demonology Warlock, the deliberate "the source reported no changes" case) and zero specs lack a raid-scoped or an M+-scoped expert read. WCL zones 54/52/56/57 were NOT fetched by this agent (no credentials); their state is recorded from wcl-fetch/evidence.json in the eight wcl-* rows above.

Discovery ran clean; distillation was impossible. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "limit-exceeded" (requested 1, fetched 0, bqVHzvKJCuA) — the Supadata free-tier monthly budget is exhausted, so no transcript existed to distil and NO take or metaNote was added; this agent fetched no transcript from YouTube or any transcript API. RSS discovery: 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff, 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries scanned against a 1045-id seen-set built from the four structured lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] plus every youtu.be id in creator-takes.json), never by regex over log prose. 26 videos were unseen, none pre-cycle. Three queue actions, all evidence-backed. (a) DEQUEUED bqVHzvKJCuA (Sha), the suspected still-live stream first flagged 2026-08-09: its RSS entry has since been re-titled "S2 Prep short stream" with published moving 2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-15 under the same id, which is live/stream metadata rather than a guess, and it has now spent a Supadata request on four separate nights while returning nothing. Per the standing rule a live stream is left UNSEEN so the finished VOD can be picked up later — it was NOT marked seen and NOT marked skipped. (b) QUEUED -sShKFuX2cQ (Dratnos, "My Raid Comp Prediction for 12.1 Venomous Abyss RWF", 2026-08-16): a raid-scoped comp read from a registered specialist, the one genuinely take-shaped upload tonight. (c) SEEN JNLnHEd_WiU (Kalamazi, "Florida Man BBQ Cooking Stream") as a durable dismissal — not WoW at all. The other 23 unseen videos were LEFT UNSEEN rather than retired, because none is a durable judgment: 9 are spec/dungeon guides or routes (Kesslive x2, Preheat x2, Megasett, Baze, Dalaran, Tactyks, Sha x2), 8 are stream or Short shaped (Bansherz, Tettles x2, Critcake, NeekapHere, AutomaticJak's "Updating Tier Lists then M0s" — whose dedicated tier-list video c_5u7Jpy-Uo is already queued — Kalamazi, Maximum, Megasett Short, Zorthas delve), 2 are Supatease uploads on a PvP-framed channel ("Finding The Best Class 12.1", "Destro Lock INSANE 12.1") and one is raw log footage (Harrek's Dummy Dome healer pulls). Queue depth is unchanged at 12 against an exhausted budget. yt-dlp was tried ONCE for metadata on bqVHzvKJCuA and hit the expected datacenter bot wall ("Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"); it was not retried and nothing was installed or upgraded. No creator `latest` field was advanced, since nothing was distilled.
